# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

**1.0.2** is the current packaged surface (OCaml **>= 4.14.1** and
**< 5.4**; CI tests **4.14.1** and **5.3.0**). Jane Street packages
resolve to v0.16 on 4.14 and v0.17 on 5.1–5.3. The next opam
package is **atproto.1.0.2**. Tagged **1.0.1** remains the prior
release.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Report security issues privately via
[GitHub Security Advisories](https://github.com/david-engelmann/atproto/security/advisories)
on this repository. There are no known vulnerabilities in 1.0.2.
